historical_references.context: During the early Islamic conquest of Egypt, the Muslim army under Amr ibn Al-As encountered a fortress named Azbak, which was defended by its Byzantine Christian ruler. After a long siege, the fortress was taken and its inhabitants were either converted to Islam or allowed to pay the poll tax (jizya) to remain in their homes.
